lines.en: Lesson 131
Don't be so sure!
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
What's the problem about deciding on a holiday?
Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
lines.zh: 盖瑞，今年你打算去哪儿度假？

lines.en: We may go abroad.
I'm not sure.
My wife wants to go to Egypt.
I'd like to go there, too.
We can't make up our minds.
Will you travel by sea or by air?
lines.zh: 你们是坐船去还是坐飞机去？

lines.en: We may travel by sea.
It's cheaper, isn't it?
It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
lines.zh: 也许便宜些，但要花很多时间。

lines.en: I'm sure you'll enjoy yourselves.
lines.zh: 我相信你们会玩得开心的。

lines.en: Don't be so sure.
We might not go anywhere.
lines.zh: 我们可能哪儿都去不了。

lines.en: My wife always worries too much.
Who's going to look after the dog?
Who's going to look after the house?
Who's going to look after the garden?
We have this problem every year.
lines.zh: 我们每年都有这个问题。

lines.en: In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
lines.zh: 结果，我们待在家里照看一切！
